types.name: cancelEdit
types.description:
This method cancels an edit to a draft order. It sends a request to the
[Cancel Draft Order Edit](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#draft-orders\_deletedraftordersidedit) API route.
types.example: sdk.admin.draftOrder.cancelEdit("order_123") .then(({ id, object, deleted }) => { console.log(id, object, deleted) })

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the item that was deleted.

children.name: object
children.description: The type of the item that was deleted.

children.name: deleted
children.description: Whether the item was deleted successfully.
